mapper.select: SELECT q.QNA_ID, q.PRODUCT_ID, q.PRODUCT_TYPE, q.QUESTION_USER_ID, q.QUESTION_CONTENT, q.REPLY_CONTENT, q.REPLY_ID, q.IS_ANSWERED, q.CREATED_TIME, q.UPDATED_TIME, CASE WHEN q.PRODUCT_TYPE = 'SALE' THEN s.TITLE WHEN q.PRODUCT_TYPE = 'AUCTION' THEN a.TITLE ELSE '상품명 없음' END as PRODUCT_TITLE, u.USER_NAME as QUESTIONER_NAME, replier.USER_NAME as REPLIER_NAME FROM qna q LEFT JOIN users u ON q.QUESTION_USER_ID = u.ID LEFT JOIN users replier ON q.REPLY_ID = replier.ID LEFT JOIN sales s ON q.PRODUCT_ID = s.SALE_ITEM_ID AND q.PRODUCT_TYPE = 'SALE' LEFT JOIN auctions a ON q.PRODUCT_ID = a.AUCTION_ID AND q.PRODUCT_TYPE = 'AUCTION' WHERE q.QUESTION_USER_ID = #{buyerId} ORDER BY q.CREATED_TIME DESC

SELECT q.QNA_ID, q.PRODUCT_ID, q.PRODUCT_TYPE, q.QUESTION_USER_ID, q.QUESTION_CONTENT, q.REPLY_CONTENT, q.REPLY_ID, q.IS_ANSWERED, q.CREATED_TIME, q.UPDATED_TIME, CASE WHEN q.PRODUCT_TYPE = 'SALE' THEN s.TITLE WHEN q.PRODUCT_TYPE = 'AUCTION' THEN a.TITLE ELSE '상품명 없음' END as PRODUCT_TITLE, u.USER_NAME as QUESTIONER_NAME, replier.USER_NAME as REPLIER_NAME FROM qna q LEFT JOIN users u ON q.QUESTION_USER_ID = u.ID LEFT JOIN users replier ON q.REPLY_ID = replier.ID LEFT JOIN sales s ON q.PRODUCT_ID = s.SALE_ITEM_ID AND q.PRODUCT_TYPE = 'SALE' LEFT JOIN auctions a ON q.PRODUCT_ID = a.AUCTION_ID AND q.PRODUCT_TYPE = 'AUCTION' WHERE q.PRODUCT_ID = #{productId} AND q.PRODUCT_TYPE = #{productType} ORDER BY q.CREATED_TIME DESC

SELECT q.QNA_ID, q.PRODUCT_ID, q.PRODUCT_TYPE, q.QUESTION_USER_ID, q.QUESTION_CONTENT, q.REPLY_CONTENT, q.REPLY_ID, q.IS_ANSWERED, q.CREATED_TIME, q.UPDATED_TIME, CASE WHEN q.PRODUCT_TYPE = 'SALE' THEN s.TITLE WHEN q.PRODUCT_TYPE = 'AUCTION' THEN a.TITLE ELSE '상품명 없음' END as PRODUCT_TITLE, u.USER_NAME as QUESTIONER_NAME, replier.USER_NAME as REPLIER_NAME FROM qna q LEFT JOIN users u ON q.QUESTION_USER_ID = u.ID LEFT JOIN users replier ON q.REPLY_ID = replier.ID LEFT JOIN sales s ON q.PRODUCT_ID = s.SALE_ITEM_ID AND q.PRODUCT_TYPE = 'SALE' LEFT JOIN auctions a ON q.PRODUCT_ID = a.AUCTION_ID AND q.PRODUCT_TYPE = 'AUCTION' WHERE q.QNA_ID = #{qnaId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO qna (QNA_ID, PRODUCT_ID, PRODUCT_TYPE, QUESTION_USER_ID, QUESTION_CONTENT, IS_ANSWERED, CREATED_TIME, UPDATED_TIME) VALUES (qna_seq.NEXTVAL, #{productId}, #{productType}, #{questionUserId}, #{questionContent}, 'N', SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE qna SET REPLY_CONTENT = #{sellerReply}, REPLY_ID = #{replyId}, IS_ANSWERED = 'Y', UPDATED_TIME = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE QNA_ID = #{qnaId}
